using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.Commands;
using Xunit;

namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.Tests.Commands
{
    public class TranslateCommandTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task TranslateAbpTranslateInfoAsync_LogsWriteTranslationJsonMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<TranslateCommand>>();
            var command = new TranslateCommand
            {
                Logger = loggerMock.Object
            };

            // We cannot call TranslateAbpTranslateInfoAsync directly because it's private,
            // so we test it indirectly by calling ExecuteAsync with options that trigger it.
            // However, this requires a lot of setup and dependencies.
            // Instead, we test the logging by invoking the method via reflection.

            var method = typeof(TranslateCommand).GetMethod("TranslateAbpTranslateInfoAsync", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
            Assert.NotNull(method);

            // Setup parameters for the method
            string directory = System.IO.Directory.GetCurrentDirectory();
            string targetCulture = "fr";
            string referenceCulture = "en";
            bool allValues = false;
            string authKey = "dummy-auth-key";

            // Act
            var task = (Task)method.Invoke(command, new object[] { directory, targetCulture, referenceCulture, allValues, authKey });
            await task;

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Write translation json to")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.AtLeastOnce);
        }
    }
}

            // Prepare a temporary directory with minimal files to avoid exceptions

            var referenceFile = Path.Combine(tempDir, "en.json");

            // Use reflection to call the private method
            var method = typeof(TranslateCommand).GetMethod("TranslateAbpTranslateInfoAsync", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
            Assert.NotNull(method);

            string targetCulture = "fr";
            string referenceCulture = "en";
            bool allValues = false;
            string authKey = "dummy-auth-key";

            // Act
            var task = (Task)method.Invoke(command, new object[] { tempDir, targetCulture, referenceCulture, allValues, authKey });
            await task;

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains($"Write translation json to {targetFile}.")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, System.Exception, string>>()),
                Times.AtLeastOnce);

            // Cleanup
            File.Delete(referenceFile);
            File.Delete(targetFile);
            Directory.Delete(tempDir);
        }
    }
}
